title: Normal domain ascent at a prime of an etale algebra
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings with S an etale R-algebra [def-weil-etale-morphism], and let q be a prime ideal of S. If the localization of R at q contracted to R is an integrally closed domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], then S localized at q is an integrally closed domain. No Noetherian assumption or domain assumption on the unlocalized rings is imposed.

theorem Algebra.Etale.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_localization_of_comap {R A : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Algebra.Etale R A] (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime (P.comap (algebraMap R A))) ∧
      IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime (P.comap (algebraMap R A)))) :
    IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime P)
